author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages

slides.title: Change the plan late, pay *twice*
slides.body: A planning playbook for production and supply planners

slides.title: What a time fence *is*
bullets: An agreed line in the calendar
It sets how freely the plan may change
Closer to today means harder to change

slides.title: Frozen, slushy, *liquid*
bullets: Frozen, weeks 1 to 2: named approver only
Slushy, weeks 3 to 4: inside agreed limits

slides.title: Track schedule *adherence*
bullets: Batches made as planned ÷ batches planned
Review it weekly with sales and production

slides.title: Log every fence *break*
bullets: One reason and one approver per break
Same reason twice? Fix the process
Check in 30 days: are breaks falling?

slides.title: A plan that always moves is a *wish*
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
